facts.text: At Tusculum University, the term Civic Arts replaces the phrase liberal arts, drawing on Cicero and the Roman villa from which Tusculum takes its name.

sources.title: Civic Arts - Tusculum University
sources.quote: At Tusculum University, the term Civic Arts replaces the phrase “liberal arts” and renews its meaning to as it was first used by Cicero, the Roman orator, philosopher, statesman and educator from whose villa Tusculum takes its name.
